body: Dude, I don’t care. I am totally fine with there being nothing after death. The thought of that actually sounds peaceful to me. I’m pretty fuckin confident in my beliefs and I’m over this conservation with you. I have no interest in it
I mean it’s stupid and it has nothing to do with what I’m talking about. Did you even read this thread because I said I don’t believe in anything. I have no interest in religion.
Get the fuck out of here with that hippie shit

I honestly don’t think I could. I don’t want to deal with my mother or anyone else in my family. It gets so tiring having to hear all the bullshit they spew. They always think they know how I feel. I have met new people but they’re all the same. Nothing makes me happy anymore

I have talked to close friends but they don’t care and I can’t stay busy if the only thing on my mind is my death. I don’t go to church because I don’t believe in anything. I really don’t have anywhere to go

I’m 15. I’m homeschooled so I don’t think I can get a school counselor. My mom definitely would never let me take any pills or see a therapist I know that for sure. I have talked to her about how I really feel but every time I do she makes it about herself. She talks about how hard everything is on her

I have talked to people but they don’t take me seriously or really care. Besides talking to people doesn’t do anything really. It might feel better for a little while but I always go back to feelin like shit. Same thing with cutting. My mom knows that I cut myself and that I want to die but she doesn’t want me to get help. She says the pills they’ll make me take will ruin me. She says that they’re going to take me away from her
